meta.name: EduTrio School ERP - API Contract
meta.description: Single source of truth for every API: request payload and response. Frontend types, Zod schemas and MSW mock handlers MUST be generated/derived from this file. If a new endpoint is needed, add it here FIRST.
meta.multiTenancy: Every authenticated request is scoped to the tenant (school) inside the JWT. Clients never send tenantId.
meta.refSyntax: A value of {"$ref": "#/components/entities/X"} means 'the full object shape X'. 'items' arrays of $ref are lists of X.

headers.X-Session-Id: Optional academic session id (ses_...). Defaults to the active session.
headers.Idempotency-Key: Required on payment and bulk-commit POSTs (uuid)

conventions.idFormat: Prefixed string ids e.g. stu_8f3a, stf_21bc, cls_01
conventions.money: Integer in the smallest currency unit is NOT used; use decimal number with 2 digits (INR). Currency lives on tenant.

permissions.description: Permission keys used by RBAC. Format: module.action. Roles are sets of these keys.
